explanation.what: invoiceOf is a free function that constructs an Invoice from an InvoiceRow.
explanation.why: AGENTS.md says "`Invoice` is the domain object. Building an `Invoice` from anything else, such as a request body or a stored row, is a static factory on `Invoice`, as `Invoice.from(id, body)` is, never a free function. A free function is for a module-private helper that touches no domain object." This change added invoiceOf, and its exemption for module-private helpers covers only those that touch no domain object.
explanation.fix: Make it a static factory on Invoice, such as Invoice.fromRow(row), and call that from get and unpaid.

arguments.failureScenario: invoiceOf builds an Invoice from an InvoiceRow as a free function in store.ts. AGENTS.md says "`Invoice` is the domain object. Building an `Invoice` from anything else, such as a request body or a stored row, is a static factory on `Invoice`, as `Invoice.from(id, body)` is, never a free function. A free function is for a module-private helper that touches no domain object." invoiceOf is module-private but constructs an Invoice, so the exemption does not cover it. A reader looking on Invoice for the ways to build one finds Invoice.from and not invoiceOf, and the next reader of rows writes a third.
